newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ministop shares up after dividend news.
newsitem.headline: Ministop shares up after dividend news.

text.p: Shares in Ministop Co Ltd rose on Wednesday following its announcement on Tuesday that the convenience store operator had revised up its dividend forecast for the current financial year.
As of 0406 GMT, Ministop's shares were up 140 yen at 3,040 yen in a turnover of 27,600. It was the fourth biggest percentage gainer on the first section.

On Tuesday, Ministop announced that it had raised its ordinary dividend forecast to 23 yen for the year to February 28, 1997, up from its previous forecast of 21 yen. It also plans a 1.1-for-1 share split on April 18, for shareholders on record as of February 28.
